_doc: Vharlen's own wanderers (Expansion 1), laid over data/provinces/wanderers.json key by key (js/sim/province-files.js). Same shapes and fields as the home file (read its _doc): `stopNear`, `shop` (a kind in `shops` here, merged into the shop kinds), `offers: deliver` (the island road-events `deliver` texts, data/provinces/vharlen-road-events.json), `curious` (a `lore` line and once a `tip`), `offers: cart` + `vehicle: ox_cart` (the cart model the client has) with crew role `carter` = the island's cart for hire, `ash_hauler`, which data/provinces/vharlen-carts.json `roaming` names. A `tip` good is an id of data/provinces/vharlen-shops.json goodsCatalog.

strand_pedlar.name: Strand Pedlar
strand_pedlar.blurb: Floats, hooks, beads and blades, all off the back of one patient mule.

wreck_picker.name: Wreck-Picker's Barrow
wreck_picker.blurb: Whatever the last storm put on the beach, now for sale.

bundle_runner.name: Bundle Runner
bundle_runner.blurb: Council bundles, hamlet letters, and sandals worn to string.

fen_mother.name: Fen Mother
fen_mother.blurb: Sending word ahead to a child who moved to town.

tale_teller.name: Tale-Teller
tale_teller.blurb: Knows a story for every cairn on this road, and a different one on the way back.

rim_scholar.name: Rim Keeper Scholar
rim_scholar.blurb: Measuring the ash layers with a knotted cord and a great deal of patience.

harbour_veteran.name: Old Harbour Guard
harbour_veteran.blurb: Walks the roads he once kept the raiders off, out of habit.

ash_hauler.name: Ash-Road Hauler
ash_hauler.blurb: A cart for hire on the island roads. It will take you to the next town, or any town, for a few coins.

isle_pedlar.name: Strand Pedlar's Basket
isle_pedlar.says: Have a rummage. Touch the glass, not the blades.

lore: They say the Glass Kings poured their palace out of the mountain while it was still hot, and it set before they could change their minds.
Never whistle near a vent. The vents whistle back, and they are louder.
The bowls at the Rim Shrine are never empty. Nobody has ever seen who fills them.
A salamander that sits still in the open is either very old or waiting for you. Either way, go round.
Port Vharl is the second harbour. The first one is under the black sand, roofs and all.
The Slagborn say the mountain spoke to their first chief. Most hearths say it was the fumes.
Toss a glass bead into the caldera lake and the mountain owes you one. It has never once paid.
My grandmother swore the lava tubes run under the sea all the way to the mainland.

tips.say: Here, for listening to an old fool. Buy yourself something cool to drink.
Take this. The road is long and the steam-cooks charge double.
A swallow for the road. Don't tell the tapper where you got it.
Word is there's something nasty nesting near {place}. Worth a look, if you're the sort.
